insolation_searth.formula: S / S_earth = (L_star / L_sun) / (a / au)^2, the flux at the planet computed by the reference from its host luminosity and orbit; not a direct measurement
insolation_searth.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars pl_insol (Gilbert et al. 2023)

mass_mearth.assumption: mass estimated from the planet's radius with the Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relation (archive pl_bmassprov = 'M-R relationship', pscp_calc.html); not a measured mass
mass_mearth.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars calculated value (pscp_calc.html), pl_bmasse

nightside_temp_K.source: not available: the literature registry (backend/assets/literature.toml) has no eclipse or phase-curve value for this planet

orbit_au.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars pl_orbsmax (Pass et al. 2026)

orbit_ecc.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars pl_orbeccen (Gilbert et al. 2023)

orbital_period_d.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars pl_orbper (Pass et al. 2026)

radius_rjup.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars pl_rade x R_earth / R_Jup (6378.1366 km / 71492 km) (Pass et al. 2026)

teq_K.assumption: the cited paper's own albedo and heat redistribution (often zero Bond albedo and full redistribution; the Kepler KOI table assumes A = 0.3; the archive row does not say which); an equilibrium temperature, not a measured one
teq_K.formula: Teq = T_star * sqrt(R_star / (2a)) * (1 - A)^(1/4), as computed in the cited paper
teq_K.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive PSCompPars pl_eqt (Rodriguez et al. 2020)

render_params.alt_text: TOI-700 d, Rocky planet, 0.102 Jupiter radii (measured), artist's colour, lit by its star. Surface relief: illustrative.

confidence.formula: C = sum(w_i c_i) / sum(w_i): c is 1 for a measured value or a formula of measured values, a placeholder share for a model-dependent one, and 0 for an assumed, artistic or missing one; the w_i are placeholder weights (D-36, Q-221)
confidence.found: Data for: Radius, mass, orbit and tides, temperature and host star.
confidence.note: This is how much of the picture rests on data. It is not the probability that the picture is correct.
confidence.weights_note: Placeholder weights: they come from the approved prototype until a sensitivity sweep replaces them (D-36).
